metricScopes.continuity: Contiguous actual submitted48kHz PCM on measured existing fixtureSinkBeginQPC + submittedFrame/48000. Controls use actual owned producerFrame-to-submittedFrame lineage. No fitted intercept, resampling or reordering.
metricScopes.nativeClosePassFit: Native sourceY equals first listenerY via offsetY0. Actual pan is constant zero; the generic headless lateral-pass ideal usesY200.1 versus nativeY200.11. Both clock fits, including pressure, are unidentifiable and excluded. Original guard-failure prefix remains privately preserved.
metricScopes.deliveryLatency: Actual submissionQPC + within512-frame offset relative to authored observationQPC. This is buffer admission, not a physical sample presentation clock. Keep delivery variation separate from uniform PCM continuity.
metricScopes.resolution: 3.5ms is grid/window fit resolution only, not complete delivery-latency uncertainty or a statistical confidence interval. Measured wake lateness and interval spread remain explicit.
metricScopes.retainedPacketAgeSinceReceiptMs: Every-block age of the retained latest packet since receipt; not pure queue wait. receiptToFirstConsumptionMaxMs is the separate once-per-packet consumption maximum.
metricScopes.costs: Matched core work is DSP+simulation in both versions. Full pipeline includes worker roundtrip/stdout and is unavailable in the original; do not compare these differing scopes.
metricScopes.longTrace: At most4094prefixblocks plus latest overflowblock and terminal. Active trace summaries are prefix-limited; final whole-run counters and all submitted PCM/recording hashes remain complete.

limitations: No new subjective listening, GTA session or physical endpoint was used.
Submission QPC plus within512-frame offset measures the real owned device-free handoff, not speaker presentation time. Unix anchor pairing uncertainty is retained for publication-age metrics.

Fixed1ms lag search on5ms energy windows has3.5ms grid/window resolution, not a complete delivery-latency uncertainty or statistical confidence interval. Measured wake lateness and interval spread are retained separately. No fitted gain, intercept, resampling, reordering or independent normalization.
The deterministic512-frame clock does not reproduce native per-receipt scheduling; actual native recorded PCM comparisons establish that effect.
Native long traces retain4094prefixblocks, latest overflow block and terminal. Dropped trace counts remain visible; complete submitted PCM and four-file hashes remain available.
Device-free sink wake lateness is reported separately from underflows; no claim about live WASAPI deadlines or GTA frame rate.
Hardware-unavailable hosted runs do not prove GPU pressure; dispatch/applied counts and actual overlapping intervals are required locally.
